environment: Local desktop Chrome, isolated 127.0.0.1:5187 practice page, November 23, 2026.
method: The public React UI rendered and captured the actor in Chrome. Network fixtures intercepted status, round and observation with scripted guesses and verdicts. All other API requests were denied at the fixture server. Go through the cases by reading look count, original balloon text and settled states. Keyboard pose edits and clicks were dispatched in the browser DOM.
scope: This records UI behavior for controlled inputs. It made no provider calls and measures neither model accuracy nor paid semantic referee behavior. Standalone Playwright Chromium launch was blocked by local macOS process sandbox (bootstrap_check_in 1100); this receipt comes from a separate Chrome session.

timedShow.method: Local Chrome issued the start, guess, next-draw, and post-expiry pose edit from the real UI. The fixture advanced the monotonic clock without waiting real minutes and withheld the simulated provider response while the clock was paused.
